name: c-herald-guilds-chars
note: Herald character pages on Merlin and Percival (the owner's default servers), about 150 each, one capture per character, plus a small guild sample: real era class mixes, levels, realm ranks and guild sizes for our bot rosters. chardisplay.php is confirmed by the first run's map; the guild URL form is still a guess until b1-herald-map reaches 'g'.

targets.note: Character pages on Merlin. Seen in the first map as chardisplay.php?s=<Server>&c=<id>. The archive's index sorts query parameters (?c=..&s=..), so a prefix on '?s=Merlin&c=' would find nothing: the server is matched by filter instead.

Character pages on Percival. Seen in the first map as chardisplay.php?s=<Server>&c=<id>. The archive's index sorts query parameters (?c=..&s=..), so a prefix on '?s=Percival&c=' would find nothing: the server is matched by filter instead.
GUESS: the guild database's path (opened February 2002 at /guilds/); a small unfiltered sample.
